description: cicmtools is a collection of external objects for Pure Data designed for 2D and 3D sound spatialization across multiphonic speaker layouts. It includes objects for Ambisonic B-format spatialization ([ambipan~], [ambicube~]) and Vector Base Amplitude Panning ([vbapan~]).

research.notes: Originally developed in 2003–2004 by Rémi Mignot and colleagues at CICM (Centre de recherche Informatique et Création Musicale) / MSH Paris Nord / Paris 8 University, the project was later abandoned. The Pure Data version was subsequently updated and packaged for Deken with 64-bit support and vanilla-compatible help files by Alexandre Torres Porres.
